description: This file defines the interface for CRC algorithms used in the eCos embedded operating system, including function declarations for various CRC computations such as CRC32, Ethernet CRC, and CRC16.

methods.name: cyg_crc32
methods.description: Computes CRC32 based on Gary S. Brown's algorithm.

methods.name: cyg_crc32_accumulate
methods.description: Accumulates CRC32 from a previous CRC value.

methods.name: cyg_ether_crc32_accumulate
methods.description: Accumulates Ethernet CRC32 from a previous CRC value.
